rules.description: A worker may edit files in its own disposable worktree; nothing reaches your branch until you approve the patch.
A worker may run its verify step in its worktree; skep still re-verifies the patch itself before it can land.
A worker may run cargo test without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run git diff without a card, since it only shows changes; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run git log without a card, since it only reads history; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run git status without a card, since it only reads the repository's state; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run go test without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run npm install without a card to install the project's packages; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run npm test without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run pnpm install without a card to install the project's packages; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run pnpm test without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run pytest without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run uv run pytest without a card to test its change in the project's environment; the Queen's own shell still asks.
A worker may run uv sync without a card to install the project's Python dependencies; the Queen's own shell still asks.

Any other shell command asks first. A worker approval can be remembered as a command prefix, which also covers longer commands that start with it (a remembered Queen command covers only that exact line); a bare interpreter or its eval flag (node, node -e, python -c) is never remembered, and the floor's denies still apply.
Writes inside the run's workspace are allowed: it is a disposable copy, and changes reach your repo only as an approved patch.
A write anywhere outside the workspace asks first, so nothing beyond the copy changes without you.
Workers may connect to files.pythonhosted.org, where PyPI serves package files.
Workers may connect to proxy.golang.org to download Go modules.
Workers may connect to pypi.org (that host only, not its subdomains) to install Python packages.
Workers may connect to registry.npmjs.org to install JavaScript packages.
The Queen's keyless web search runs without a card; no host pattern could cover the engines it rotates through.
A connection to any other host asks first.
Reading a web page with read_url asks first for every host, so you see where the Queen wants to go.
Every MCP tool asks first: coding work needs none by default.
Reading mail asks first: coding work has no reason to open your inbox.
Sending mail, or any other email side effect, asks first and the card shows what would go out.
Acting on a page (navigating, clicking, typing, running JavaScript) asks first.
Reading a browser page's state asks first: coding work does not browse by default.
